name: FFL Checkout by Texas Technology Group
author: Texas Technology Group | Vladyslav Kotyk

sections.description:
The FFL checkout tool allows you to sell firearms online and ship them to a licensed dealer. For online firearm orders that require transfers to FFL dealers, FFL checkout facilitates the process for you (the firearm dealer) AND your customers, allowing them to select the dealer of their choice!

It provides customers with an easy-to-use search tool that includes a map and a zip code search. We have access to the most accurate data and the most up-to-date database of FFL, complete with PDFs if they are verified.

We used the most advanced address look-up software to provide accurate FFL locations for the customer. FFLs are either verified or not. If they are, we have the PDF and all the information on file ready to be downloaded from FFLs.com. If our database does not have the FFL the customer is using, they can upload a current copy, which is attached to the order.

  • We provide your customers with a list of FFL dealers to whom they can ship their firearms for pickup.
  • If we don’t have their preferred FFL in our database, we will allow them to upload it.
  • For you, the online store owner, we send you the selected FFL dealer information along with a digital copy of its license for you to verify and keep on file.
  • The FFL is attached to the order, and we have a link for you to check its status on the Ezcheck system.

Handle selling guns and making transfers more efficiently while boosting sales with quicker customer checkout and reduced cart abandonment rate.

This plugin is supported by FFLs.com, which is part of Fastbound. They have the largest, most complete database of FFLs and the best data system that scans the ATF FFL database weekly and updates FFL information (including FFL documents) in real time as the information is received.

How much does the Plugin cost

Our pricing is simple: $99.99 per site per year. Use as many queries as needed, and allow customers unlimited uploads, which we will add to the database!

How the Plugin Works

When a product has the FFL required option enabled, the FFL checkout block will be displayed to the client during the checkout process. The client can choose an FFL (Federal Firearms License) holder. The admin can later view the chosen FFL details, verified using the FFLS.com API, using the order details.

Why is this plug better than the other alternatives?

Easy to use, Easy to set up Gun industry experts and pro 2A friends of the industry built it; this is not an overpriced complex system as other companies push. We don’t mess with costly third-party anti-gun clouds – we don’t need them. We own and operate our servers; we have a cloud, but we own it. We own and operate our hosting environment so that nothing gets banned or shut down. This means that downtime will be minimal, and performance will be consistent. Did I mention that it’s the cheapest online solution with the most features?

How to Bulk Update Products to be FFL Required

To bulk update products to be marked as FFL required, navigate to the product management section of your WordPress admin dashboard. Select the products you wish to update, choose the bulk action to edit, and set the FFL required option.

What is an FFL?

A Federal Firearms Licensee (FFL) is an individual or a business entity that has obtained a license from the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF), a U.S. Department of Justice branch. This license grants them legal authorization to engage in the commercial sale, manufacture, or importation of firearms and ammunition.

Having an FFL implies that the licensee has undergone a thorough vetting process and is subject to stringent government regulations to ensure that firearms transactions are conducted lawfully and responsibly. This includes maintaining comprehensive records of firearm acquisitions and dispositions, conducting background checks on prospective buyers to verify eligibility, and adhering to specific security and reporting requirements. FFLs.com helps your customers find an FFL near them quickly at checkout!

All online firearm dealers have an FFL and want to ensure the sale and shipment of their products are executed safely while adhering to all U.S. laws and regulations. The Texas Technology Group has built a system that simplifies your online sales. In addition to helping customers through the FFL selection and checkout process, we built features for the dealer to optimize their fulfillment process. On the order details page, you will see an FFL Download link, which will connect you to FFLs.com and allow you to download the FFL. We also provided a quick and easy ezCheck link to verify the data instantly.

Email: cs@texastechnologygroup.com

  • Leaflet.js – open-source library for mobile-friendly interactive maps Check license

  • FFLs.com – FFL data for the checkout block

  • Texas technology group FFL checkout API – Provides data for checkout block, allows licenses uploads
